summary: This bill prohibits the Secretary of Energy from providing financial assistance to investor-owned electric utilities that raise residential electricity rates above their January 1, 2026, levels, and for a subsequent period, ties such assistance to restrictions on executive compensation if rates are increased.

The core of the bill is about these conditions on financial assistance.
